slug: 2023-10-07 Centrafrique - la delivrance de la carte nationale d'identite facilitee pour les habitants de Bossangoa

facts.fact: Radio Ndeke Luka reports that the firm Al Madina produces the national identity card, enrolling applicants (photo, fingerprint, signature) and printing cards in Bangui, with 2,500 applicants targeted at Bossangoa.

systems.tiers: produced by Al Madina; enrolment at police station, cards printed in Bangui
